scientific_scope_status: The accepted elastic-layer and joint stopped-vector construction adds N rows of N real charges to an N by N material. Growing stiffness and actual local jitter yield joint auxiliary density near one with super-volume tails. A delayed capped controller implements (rho,W)->(rho+1,W+[psi(y,t,S h)-h]e_x) at speed N^2, preserving a separately warranted native density-path rate by contraction.
